clues.text: This coaster reaches a top speed of 40 mph, stands 67 feet tall, and features 0 inversions.
This coaster was manufactured by B&M and opened to the public in 2025.
This coaster is located at a popular theme park in the state of Virginia.
This ride was constructed on the former site of Drachen Fire, an Arrow Dynamics custom looping coaster that closed in 1998.
The ride's name suggests that a classic, huffing-and-puffing fairy tale canine villain is back to exact payback.

evidence.quote: The Big Bad Wolf: The Wolf's Revenge is a family inverted roller coaster at Busch Gardens Williamsburg in Williamsburg, Virginia.
It was built on the site of Drachen Fire, an Arrow Dynamics Custom Looping Coaster that closed in 1998.
